Hilbert series of modules over degree two tca's

What can we say about Hilbert series of modules over $A = \mathrm{Sym}(\mathrm{Sym}^2)$. More precisely, take $M$ to be $A$ modulo a determinantal ideal. Is it true that its $($non-exponential$)$ Hilbert series is algebraic? Assume characteristic $0$.
